name: Clinical Event Kernel

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A clinical command is reported as saved while the event, its audit entry, its idempotency record or its outbox message was not durably committed (partial write, unavailable store).
foreseeableSequence: store unavailable or transaction fails midway
clinical action believed recorded but absent
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Lost clinical record or duplicated command on retry; decisions taken on data that does not exist.

controls.name: Atomic clinical command: event + idempotency + audit + outbox in one transaction; store failure -> 503, never a false save

invariants.statement: A clinical command is either fully committed (event, idempotency record, audit entry, outbox message) or not at all; an unavailable store yields DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, never a reported success.

safetyArgument: Authority establishes intended behavior and boundaries.
Controls prevent, detect, correct, or recover from those conditions.
Invariants define conditions that must remain true.
Tests provide executable oracles; execution evidence is separately required.
Capability remains blocked when any required safety-case element is absent.
